title: Complement C3d Deposition on Erythrocytes as a Candidate Biomarker of Extravascular Hemolysis in Paroxysmal Nocturnal Hemoglobinuria: An Exploratory Single-Center Study.
publicationName: Mayo Clinic proceedings. Innovations, quality & outcomes
journalName: Mayo Clinic proceedings. Innovations, quality & outcomes
snippet: To evaluate complement component 3 (C3) deposition on paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) cells by flow cytometry and its clinical relevance as a marker of significant extravascular hemolysis (EVH).
